lines.about.source: Slyrim is an original game. The game The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim (Bethesda Game Studios, 2011) gave the idea. Bethesda Softworks and ZeniMax Media did not make this game and are not connected to it.
lines.dev.about.v_source: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim (Bethesda Game Studios, 2011)
lines.dev.about.v_genre: Open-world action RPG with stealth and theft
lines.dev.about.v_perspective: Third person (default) and first person, switchable; shared and split-screen chase cameras for local play
lines.dev.about.v_tech: my-3D2dge 0.101.0 (2D and 3D engines, patched); three.js 0.182.0 (WebGPURenderer, WebGL 2 fallback); Rapier 0.19.3 (rapier3d-simd-compat); Web Audio API; 52in1 session client 1.4.0; one HTML file; bun for bundling; Playwright 1.63.0 for tests
lines.dev.about.v_art: my-3D2dge native 3D: a low-resolution pixel picture, procedural terrain and structure textures, pixel-art characters on cards, low-poly pen-drawn dragons and creatures; a cold northern palette with firelight and aurora
lines.dev.about.v_animation: Procedural: engine Humanoid rigs with E.MOVES and new poses, procedural creature and dragon skeletons with IK feet, first-person arms on the overlay pen, scripted set pieces with timers
lines.dev.about.v_audio: All Web Audio code: synthesized instruments for music at 10% default volume, synthesized sound effects, syllable-driven gibberish voices
lines.dev.about.v_online: 52in1 sessions: parallel, ghost, shared-world co-op and versus (session protocol 1, client 1.4.0)
lines.dev.about.v_testing: Headless Chromium through Playwright 1.63.0 (WebGL 2 on SwiftShader); Node unit tests; a scripted full playthrough with an autopilot; the 52in1 session harness in every online mode; the catalogue checker; emulated pads and phone profiles; OfflineAudioContext checks; screenshots and filmstrips at 1920x1080 looked at by eye
lines.dev.about.v_research: The plan's research (the my-3D2dge 0.101.0 handoff, the 52in1 session, catalogue and languages pages, a single-file packaging test), plus reading the engine source and API for every system used
lines.dev.about.testing_a1: The scripted playthrough. The autopilot plays every quest with real inputs, and it found most content bugs: missing stage triggers, interiors built twice, bad spawn rules.
lines.dev.about.testing_a2: Full-size screenshots under software rendering. They are slow and show little that the state checks do not show.
lines.dev.about.engine_q2: What one thing would you change?
lines.dev.about.engine_a1: One file gives a 3D world, physics, rigs, a pen for procedural models, input with pads and a pause menu. No asset files are necessary.
lines.dev.about.engine_a2: A documented way to keep several worlds (a terrain world and many interiors, each with physics) and switch between them. Much glue code did this.
lines.dev.about.prompt_a1: The plan fixes the model, the tool and the environment in advance. The game was built in another environment, so those values do not match the run.
lines.dev.about.prompt_a2: Let the builder fill the model and environment fields from the real run, and keep the scope smaller so each feature gets more polish.
lines.dev.about.c_code: Game design and code: an AI agent, Anthropic Claude, in Claude Code.
lines.dev.about.c_plan: Plan: the lead architect and designer session (plan.md).
lines.dev.about.c_assets: Asset sets: none. Every model, texture and sound is made in code.
lines.dev.about.c_motion: Motion clips: none. All motion is procedural.
lines.help.move.title: Moving
lines.help.move.p1: Use {key:up} {key:left} {key:down} {key:right} or the left stick to move. Hold {key:sprint} to sprint.
lines.help.move.p2: Press {key:jump} to jump. Press {key:sneak} to sneak. Press {key:view} to change between first and third person.
lines.help.move.p3: Press {key:interact} to use the thing in front of you. Hold it on a small thing to carry it.
lines.help.fight.title: Fighting
lines.help.fight.p1: Press {key:ready} to take out your weapon. Press {key:attack} to attack with the right hand.
lines.help.fight.p2: Hold {key:block} to block. Hold {key:attack} to do a power attack. A power attack uses stamina.
lines.help.fight.p3: A bow attack: hold {key:attack} to draw, then release. A full draw does more damage.
lines.help.magic.title: Magic
lines.help.magic.p1: Equip a spell in a hand from the Magic menu. Press the hand button to cast it.
lines.help.magic.p2: Some spells charge: hold the button, then release. Some spells stream while you hold the button.
lines.help.magic.p3: Magicka comes back after you stop casting.
lines.help.shout.title: Shouts
lines.help.shout.p1: Read a Voice Stone to learn a word. A dragon soul unlocks the word.
lines.help.shout.p2: Hold {key:shout} to shout. Tap for one word. Hold longer for two or three words.
lines.help.shout.p3: After a shout, you must wait before you shout again.
lines.help.sneak.title: Sneaking and theft
lines.help.sneak.p1: The eye on the screen shows if enemies see you. Dark places and slow steps help you.
lines.help.sneak.p2: A sneak attack on an enemy that does not see you does more damage.
lines.help.sneak.p3: Red words show things that are not yours. If a person sees you take them, you get a bounty.
lines.help.skills.title: Skills and levels
lines.help.skills.p1: You get better at a skill when you use it. Skill increases raise your level.
lines.help.skills.p2: At a new level, choose health, magicka or stamina. You also get a perk point.
lines.help.skills.p3: Touch one of the Three Stones to get its blessing.
lines.help.craft.title: Crafting
lines.help.craft.p1: Mine ore with a pickaxe. Smelt the ore into bars at a smelter.
lines.help.craft.p2: Make weapons and armour at an anvil. Improve them at a workbench.
lines.help.craft.p3: Mix two ingredients with the same effect at an alchemy table to make a potion.
lines.help.world.title: The world
lines.help.world.p1: Open the map to see the places you found. Fast travel to a place you found.
lines.help.world.p2: Press {key:wait} to wait. Sleep in a bed to restore everything.
lines.help.world.p3: Quests show their objective under the compass. Gold diamonds show where to go.
lines.help.together.title: Play together
lines.help.together.p1: Play Together starts a game for two to four players on one screen or a split screen.
lines.help.together.p2: Each player uses a controller, or one player uses the keyboard.
lines.help.together.p3: Dragon Hunt is a short challenge: kill the red dragon at North Watch as fast as you can.
